description: Context-decoupled block demux using the counted fx2 structural backend independently on skeleton, prose, and numeric streams, with raw-fx2 fallback.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
hypothesis: Asynchronous structural/prose/numeric streams may preserve specialized contexts better than one flat byte stream while staying lossless and decoder-reproducible.
verdict: Pruned on the 250k exact gate. The fx2 backend rejected demux: independent skeleton/prose/numeric streams were 1402 archive bytes worse than raw fx2 before the larger wrapper was counted.
